articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: Core CPI Inflation Holds At Low 2.6%; S&P 500 Futures, Fed Rate-Cut Odds Rise (Live Coverage). articles.summary: PR Newswire: ChinaAMC slashes fee for ten mega-ETFs to the industry lowest, potentially saving investors billions. China Asset Management Co. (ChinaAMC) announced that it has slashed the expense ratio on 10 mega-ETFs to the industry's lowest level, a move that could save investors billions of yuan annually.
